description: Search indexed envelopes (from/to/subject/date). `query` matches sender and subject. `body_query` additionally full-parses candidate messages to search body text — it is capped, so narrow with sender/date filters first; the result reports how many candidates were scanned.

after.description: Only messages on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

before.description: Only messages on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD

body_query.description: Substring searched in message bodies (bounded scan)

path.description: Path to an .mbox file (e.g. a Google Takeout export) or a directory of .eml files

query.description: Keyword matched against sender and subject

name: search_messages
title: Search the archive
